remarks: This single-family, center hall colonial is a 3 (or possibly 4) bedroom, 3.5 bath residence in Stamford's sought-after Springdale neighborhood and is ready for your finishing touches! The main level features a traditional layout, complete with a spacious living room, dining room (was once open to the kitchen) and a large kitchen that boasts ample cabinetry and counter space. Upstairs, you'll find large and comfortable bedrooms, including a primary suite with a private bath and a walk-in closet. A semi-finished lower level with a full bath provides flexible space for a family room, guest area, or home office. Enjoy the private backyard, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Conveniently located near Metro-North, shops, restaurants, and major highways (Merritt Parkway and 95). * Subject to probate approval * BOMK due to buyer financing - appraised over asking price!! This is your chance!!
